title: AI Engineer – LLM Applications & Automation
description: AI Engineer – LLM Applications & AutomationAbout the roleWe’re looking for an AI Engineer to build and improve AI-powered tools that solve real business problems. You’ll work with large language models (LLMs) to automate workflows, process business information, and help teams access and use data more effectively.This is a hands-on role for someone who can take an idea from an initial prototype through testing and into reliable day-to-day use. You’ll work closely with business teams to understand their needs, design practical solutions, and improve them based on real results.What you’ll do* Design, build, and maintain AI agents and multi-step automation workflows.* Connect LLMs to business data, internal systems, and external APIs.* Extract and organize information from emails, documents, and other unstructured sources.* Develop prompts, agent instructions, and structured outputs, including JSON.* Test AI solutions for accuracy, reliability, and cost, and improve them over time.* Build evaluation datasets and practical checks to identify errors and prevent regressions.* Explore new AI tools and open-source technologies, and recommend those that offer clear value.* Work with business teams to understand processes and turn them into useful AI solutions.* Document your work so that solutions can be maintained and improved by the team.What we’re looking for* At least two years of experience in software development or data science.* Strong Python skills and experience building applications that use APIs.* Practical experience with LLM applications, AI agents, or LLM-powered automation.* Experience with prompt design and structured outputs such as JSON.* The ability to test your work, investigate unexpected results, and improve reliability.* Good communication skills and the ability to work independently in a remote team.It would be a plus if you have* Experience with Node.js, JavaScript, or TypeScript.* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.* Experience evaluating LLM applications with tools such as promptfoo or similar.* Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases.* A background in machine learning or data analysis.What success looks like* AI workflows reliably support real business processes.* Outputs are checked and evaluated, and common errors are reduced over time.* Solutions are useful to the people who rely on them and have a clear, measurable benefit.* The team can understand, maintain, and improve the systems you build.
